describes: packages/plugin/form scripting: the standalone K/V/C/F controller and the capability over the actions realm.

cases.name: standalone-configured-environment
cases.covers: The standalone host reads the name-tree scripts once, boots once per realm with the configured file name, identity, clock, offset and seed, and commits the value; a second commit does not boot again.

cases.name: standalone-default-environment
cases.covers: Without configuration the clock is the host's, the offset the host zone's, the seed seedFrom(document id, run), the file name the document's, the identity the engine's claims; a document without catalog actions boots nothing but still builds the realm.

cases.name: standalone-identity-callback
cases.covers: An identity callback is called per run and layered over the engine claims.

cases.name: standalone-dispose
cases.covers: dispose() releases the owned realm; a later transaction rejects.

cases.name: form-values-cross-into-the-overlay
cases.covers: A toggle proposes its state (null as 'Off'), a combobox its first choice ('' for none), a listbox every choice; a value whose type does not match the family fails the transaction before any run.

error.message: Form value type 'toggle' does not match field family 'text'
Form value type 'text' does not match field family 'pushbutton'
Form value type 'choice' does not match field family 'text'

cases.name: a-cleared-toggle-proposes-off
cases.covers: A toggle to null reaches the validator as 'Off'.

cases.name: validated-values-cross-back
cases.covers: A validator's event.value becomes the committed value in the family's form: text String()s it (null as ''), a toggle maps null and 'Off' to a cleared state and stringifies the rest, a combobox keeps the first of a list, a listbox wraps a scalar.

cases.name: boot-effects-land-with-the-commit
cases.covers: A boot's form effects and UI requests join the first transaction, tagged 'boot', ahead of the user's value; later transactions see no boot.

cases.name: a-failed-boot-degrades
cases.covers: A boot that throws, or answers with an error, is a script-error diagnostic and the transaction goes on without its effects; its UI requests still surface.

diagnostics.message: Document boot script failed (continuing without it): app.findComponent is not a function

cases.name: a-boot-error-output-degrades
cases.covers: A boot output carrying an error keeps its UI requests and diagnostics, drops its form effects, and adds the degrade diagnostic.

diagnostics.message: Document boot script failed (continuing without it): not a function

cases.name: a-failed-catalog-read-degrades
cases.covers: A name-tree read that rejects degrades to the host diagnostic; the value still commits.

diagnostics.message: Document boot script failed (continuing without it): actions unavailable

cases.name: rejection-keeps-boot-effects
cases.covers: A rejected value still commits the boot effects alone and resolves rejected with their result; a boot batch that fails turns the rejection into a failure; with no batch door it fails before the engine.

cases.name: activation-runs-in-the-transaction
cases.covers: activate(ref, tree) runs the tree's JavaScript as widget-activate against the overlay and commits its effects with its UI requests; no calculation follows.

cases.name: activation-edits-its-own-field
cases.covers: An activation that sets its own field's value commits it; the activated field is not formatted, since no value was proposed.

cases.name: recalculate-keeps-a-boot-reset
cases.covers: recalculate() proposes nothing, so a boot script's reset of the anchor field survives as a reset effect.

cases.name: activation-refusals
cases.covers: An incomplete tree fails before any run; a tree with no JavaScript commits nothing; a run error fails the transaction.

error.message: Refusing to execute an incomplete PDF action tree

cases.name: keystroke-two-passes
cases.covers: A text commit runs the keystroke script twice: once paste-shaped (the whole value in change, the old value selected, willCommit false), whose selection splice becomes the proposal, then willCommit with the spliced value, whose event.value is committed.

cases.name: keystroke-splices-in-utf-16
cases.covers: The splice counts UTF-16 code units (an astral character is two), clamps a selection end before its start, and reads negative and fractional offsets the way String#slice does.

cases.name: keystroke-empty-values
cases.covers: An empty field's old value and a null proposal both reach the keystroke script as ''; the field's page is its first placed widget's index in the document, 0 when it has none or the page is unknown; a direct widget before it is passed over.

cases.name: keystroke-fault-ladder
cases.covers: An exception in either keystroke pass keeps the typed value with a diagnostic; any other error fails the transaction; a false rc in either pass rejects the value, keeping the diagnostics so far.

diagnostics.message: Keystroke script failed (kept the typed value): typing broke
Keystroke commit script failed (kept the typed value): commit broke
Keystroke script failed (kept the typed value): typing broke again

cases.name: keystroke-trees
cases.covers: An incomplete keystroke tree fails the transaction; one with no JavaScript is skipped; a keystroke on a non-text field never runs.

error.message: Refusing to execute an incomplete PDF action tree

cases.name: validate-fault-ladder
cases.covers: A validator's false rc rejects the value with its alert; an exception accepts it with a diagnostic; any other error fails; success commits the validator's value and effects.

diagnostics.message: Validate script failed (accepted the value): validator broke

cases.name: validate-trees
cases.covers: An incomplete validate tree fails; one with no JavaScript is skipped and the value commits.

error.message: Refusing to execute an incomplete PDF action tree

cases.name: calculation-order
cases.covers: The /CO chain runs in order after the user's value, skipping null and dead entries and fields without a calculate tree; an exception skips that field with a diagnostic; the target and each calculated field are formatted once, in that order.

diagnostics.message: Calculate script failed (field left unchanged): explode is not defined

cases.name: calculation-refusals
cases.covers: A calculate error that is not an exception fails the transaction, as does an incomplete calculate tree.

error.message: Refusing to execute an incomplete PDF action tree

cases.name: recalculate-anchors
cases.covers: recalculate() anchors on the first live /CO field, else the first field, and runs with no source; a first-field anchor outside the /CO chain is neither calculated nor formatted; a document with no fields is an honest no-op.

cases.name: format-fault-ladder
cases.covers: A format exception keeps the raw value with a diagnostic; any other format error fails; an incomplete format tree fails; one with no JavaScript is skipped.

diagnostics.message: Format script failed (kept the raw value): kaboom

error.message: Refusing to execute an incomplete PDF action tree

cases.name: effects-canonicalise
cases.covers: Script effects fold into the overlay: a reset back to a default becomes one leading reset effect, a later setValue un-resets (even back to the default), display changes become setDisplay, appearance text keeps the last per field in first-set order, and effects on fields the snapshot lacks are dropped.

cases.name: native-effect-statuses
cases.covers: The engine's per-effect statuses decide the result: any failed or skipped entry fails it with 'One or more native form effects failed', a rejected one fails it too, all unchanged is unchanged; an engine without a batch door fails before the call.

error.message: One or more native form effects failed
One or more native form effects failed
This engine does not support batched form effects

cases.name: no-change-is-unchanged
cases.covers: A commit of the current value produces no effects: unchanged, no engine write. A field the snapshot no longer has fails.

cases.name: a-throwing-run-fails
cases.covers: A sandbox run that throws fails the transaction with an invalid-output error carrying its message; a script setValue on a pushbutton rejects the transaction.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: Form value type 'text' does not match field family 'pushbutton'

cases.name: the-effects-budget
cases.covers: More form effects plus UI requests than maxEffects fails the transaction before the engine; exactly maxEffects passes.

cases.name: the-output-budget-at-the-boundary
cases.covers: Output bytes are the UTF-8 length of each output's JSON (192 here, with 2-, 3- and 4-byte characters): exactly the budget passes.

cases.name: the-output-budget-exceeded
cases.covers: One byte over, a boot output degrades with the budget message, and a run output that crosses the aggregate fails the transaction.

diagnostics.message: Document boot script failed (continuing without it): Form script transaction output exceeded 191 bytes

error.message: Form script transaction output exceeded 191 bytes

cases.name: the-time-budget
cases.covers: Each run receives what is left of the transaction's execution budget; once a run has taken all of it (a realm rebuilt behind a slow factory), the next run times out without reaching the sandbox, and the rebuilt realm's boot surfaces in the next transaction.

cases.name: the-time-budget-shrinks
cases.covers: A run that took 20 of the 50 budgeted milliseconds leaves the next run 30.

cases.name: commit-through-the-shared-realm
cases.covers: With scripting on, commitValue runs the K/V/C/F pipeline in the actions plugin's realm, surfaces boot UI requests, then user ones with diagnostics and the error, through the actions port, and re-reads after a batch.

cases.name: scripted-writes-clear-the-spinner
cases.covers: A scripted write that commits nothing, is rejected, or fails clears the writing mark itself; one that commits leaves it to the re-read.

cases.name: reset-recalculates
cases.covers: With scripting on, a reset recalculates the /CO chain after its batch and folds the recalculation's UI, diagnostics and error into its result, surfaced with the caller's origin.

diagnostics.message: Calculate script failed (field left unchanged): calc threw

args.message: Calculate script failed (field left unchanged): calc threw

cases.name: scripted-activation
cases.covers: When the dispatcher finds no /A tree, the form path reads the widget's activation from the page (loaded annotations first when the annotation plugin has them) and runs it as a scripted transaction; a widget without one is a scripted no-op.

cases.name: scripted-activation-reads-the-folded-annotation
cases.covers: With the annotation plugin a loaded widget answers its activation tree without a page read; one without an activation tree is a scripted no-op, and a hover tree with no root counts as none.

cases.name: script-nodes-commit-through-the-form
cases.covers: A JavaScript node's form effects reach the engine through the form plugin's commit sink, which re-reads.

cases.name: no-sandbox-host
cases.covers: A host with scripting enabled but no sandbox has no transaction port, so the form commits without scripts, exactly as with scripting disabled.
